src/kai_code/tasks/.description: Tasks module contains TaskManager singleton, Task/BackgroundShellTask/BackgroundAgentTask dataclasses, Rich panel UI, and LangChain tools. Uses threading for background execution with MAX_CONCURRENT_TASKS=5 limit and callback system for task completion.
